name: Rob Jaggers Camping Area
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10060251 (296 days observed, edges closes)
note: BLM Fort Stanton-Snowy River Cave NCA campground; 27 drive-in mostly-level gravel sites (24 with 20/30/50-amp electric + potable water), vault toilets, dump station (extra fee), no showers. About half the sites have adjoining horse corrals but it is a general campground open to all RVers. --Claude

name: Jemez Falls Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 274315 (114 days observed, edges closes)
note: USFS campground in the Jemez Mountains, Santa Fe NF, at ~8,000 ft. 52 sites with paved access taking trailers/RVs up to 40 ft (per-site max mostly 37 ft, a few 42-47 ft); no hookups. Picnic table + fire ring per site; near the Jemez Falls trail. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Elephant Rock Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251359 (101 days observed, edges closes)
note: Carson NF campground along the Red River between Questa and Red River village at ~8,400 ft. 20 single sites, potable water, vault toilets, no hookups; per-site RV max lengths range 24-39 ft (several sites take 30-39 ft). Fishing access to the stocked Red River and nearby Eagle Rock Lake. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Columbine Campground (Carson National Forest)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251436 (101 days observed, edges closes)
note: Carson NF campground between Questa and Red River at ~7,900 ft, at the Columbine Creek/Red River confluence and Columbine trailhead. 26 single sites, potable water (container fill only — no direct RV hookup), vault toilets, all dry camping; site 001 lists RV max 40 ft. Reservable online. --Claude

name: San Antonio Campground (Jemez)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233390 (149 days observed, edges closes)
note: Santa Fe NF campground on the San Antonio River in the Jemez, ~7,600 ft; 6 sites with water+electric hookups for RVs to 35 ft, picnic tables/grills, vault toilets (no dump station). Reservable online. Near La Cueva and Spence Hot Spring. --Claude

name: Agua Piedra Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234700 (108 days observed, edges closes)
note: Carson NF campground on NM-518 in the upper Rio Pueblo canyon (Camino Real RD), sites across a Lower loop plus Loop A and Loop B. The two group shelters are reservable online. Per-site max RV lengths run ~25-36 ft, so it fits a 23-ft rig. Near the Rio Pueblo and Agua Piedra Creek (trout fishing). --Claude

name: Water Canyon Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10344809 (206 days observed, edges closes)
note: Standard nonelectric sites plus a group site in the Magdalena Mountains, Cibola NF (Magdalena RD), ~6,900 ft; picnic table/fire ring/grill at each site. All drive-in; several 27-42 ft sites that fit a mid-size rig, though the final ~500 ft of dirt access road is rough-longer rigs use caution. Reservable (recreation.gov); FCFS Oct-Mar with possible weather closures. --Claude

name: Baumgartner Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232354 (104 days observed, edges closes)
note: Sawtooth NF (Fairfield RD) on the South Fork Boise River, 11 mi east of Featherville via FR 227 (dirt). 39 single/double/quad + 1 group site; vault toilets, drinking water, and the developed Baumgartner Hot Springs soaking pool within the campground. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Pine Flats
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232312 (74 days observed, edges closes)
note: Boise NF, Banks-Lowman Hwy a few miles west of Lowman above the South Fork Payette River; 26 single/double sites, paved roads and spurs (some paved pads), vault toilets, drinking water, no hookups; 1/4-mi trail to a riverside hot spring. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Mountain View Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232169 (99 days observed, edges closes)
note: Boise NF, Idaho 21 just east of Lowman above the South Fork Payette River; 14 single-family sites, paved roads and spurs, vault toilets, drinking water, no hookups; ~3 mi to Kirkham Hot Springs. Reservable online. --Claude
